title: Array fold loop
summary: Proves that the compiler's fold statement leaves Array.foldl of an Array UInt64 in the accumulator local, from one obligation about the fold body's expression.
premises: Five distinct fold locals below the scratch index
UInt64Array.At for the array in the initial store
The body evaluates to g a e whenever the accumulator holds a and the element local holds e
result: A Triple whose postcondition keeps the store, frames every other local below scratch, and puts xs.foldl g start in the accumulator.
